full_page.content:
1945, December 14
The following is a faithful transcription of message typed and written on a Christmas Card by the Servant of God Father Solanus Casey O. F.M. Cap.
(to Mrs. Helena Wilhite)
ALWAYS CHRISTMAS EVE
With love and with Christmas blessings to all Comes the INFANT once more to free us from sorrow. Whose love and Whose grace and Whose gentleness call To each heart and each soul for a manger tomorrow.
Whose Birth and Whose power and Whose wonders proclaim Him, the Son of the VIRGIN as promised of yore. 0! May He estrange us from sin with its shame! And reign in our hearts as His crib evermore.
Fr. Sol.
TO KNOW GOD -- MY WONDERFULLY PRIVILEGED PURPOSE.
God made me to know Him. O! What a blessd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's HEAVEN BEGUN for the GRATEFUL on earth
To treasure aright ! ? ! HIGHEST HEAVEN its worth.
Fr. Sol.O.F.M.Cap.
The Grace of God be with you - All and each - and His peace which surpaseth. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
P.S. Would be glad to hear from little Casey M. Tell him I said he is old enough now to think the responsibility and the privilege of working at his own Eternal salvation.
Fr. Sol.
